mapper.update: UPDATE document_chunk SET status = 0, indexing_lock_version = NULL, pending_vector_id = NULL, overlap_content = NULL, overlap_source_chunk_id = NULL, overlap_token_count = 0, overlap_character_count = 0, overlap_reduction_reason = NULL, index_content = NULL, last_error = 'Vectorization interrupted by application restart', lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND status = 1 AND indexing_lock_version = #{indexingLockVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT dc.*, parent.public_id AS parent_public_id FROM document_chunk dc LEFT JOIN document_chunk parent ON parent.id = dc.parent_chunk_id AND parent.tenant_id = dc.tenant_id AND parent.knowledge_id = dc.knowledge_id AND parent.file_id = dc.file_id WHERE dc.file_id = #{fileId} AND dc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dc.knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} ORDER BY dc.position
